'''Magnetic clamps''' were pieces of technology with several uses. The clamps were used in [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]] to keep smaller [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] like [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] secured to the deck.<ref name="RE" /> A magnetic clamp was also used to secure the main body of the [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]] to the [[TR-62 Autocushion Tripod/Legends|TR-62 Autocushion Tripod]].<ref name="EGWT" />
